text.insert: Registration resolves one game's configuration. Initial Sync and sandbox validation establish readiness, then the same harness executes Run epochs separated by Sync.

steps.text: Resolve the Game
Read games/<id>/game.json, referenced config, config/local.json overrides, and explicit options.
Resolve workspace, state, knowledge, tool, and sandbox paths from the selected game.
Require a usable configured checkout before initial Sync.
Run Initial Sync
Verify Git HEAD and initialize harness ownership.
Acquire Sync authority, stage source reconciliation, and validate the configured build.
Capture configured source inputs, import archival records, build search indexes, and reconcile mechanical entities.
Publish validated manual Sync after confirmation and persist the accepted source/evidence boundary.
Verify Sandbox Readiness
Run validate-sandbox for the selected named profile.
Compare host and Daytona reports at the accepted source head, preserve evidence, and delete the sandbox.
Require all readiness gates before Run admission.
Continue the Harness
Run an epoch, settle workers and integration, and capture epoch evidence.
Perform automatic epoch Sync under fenced source authority, including no-source-change completion.
Refresh report and board state; admit the next epoch only when desired Run and required gates permit.
Preserve Progress
Link every boundary to the stable game, harness, run, epoch, command, and trace identities.
Pause stops admission while retaining the worktree, evidence, and history.
